commands.name: producer
description: Send message(s) to a broker.

options.label: <verbose>
description: Print additional information.

options.label: <silentInput>
description: Disable all the inputs, and make a best guess for any required input.

options.label: <brokerURL>
description: Connection URL. Default: build URL from the 'artemis' acceptor defined in the broker.xml or tcp://localhost:61616 if the acceptor cannot be parsed.

options.label: <acceptor>
description: Name used to find the default connection URL on the acceptor list. If an acceptor with that name cannot be found the CLI will look for a connector with the same name.

options.label: <user>
description: User used to connect.

options.label: <password>
description: Password used to connect.

options.label: <clientID>
description: ClientID set on the connection.

options.label: <protocol>
description: Protocol used. Valid values are ${COMPLETION-CANDIDATES}

options.label: <destination>
description: Destination to be used. It can be prefixed with queue:// or topic:// and can be an FQQN in the form of <address>::<queue>. Default: queue://TEST.

options.label: <messageCount>
description: Number of messages to act on. Default: 1000.

options.label: <sleep>
description: Time wait between each message.

options.label: <oldBatchSize>
description: Transaction batch size. (deprecated)

options.label: <txBatchSize>
description: Transaction batch size.

options.label: <threads>
description: Number of threads to use. Default: 1.

options.label: <serializer>
description: The class name of the custom serializer implementation to use intead of the default.

options.label: <nonpersistent>
description: Send messages non persistently.

options.label: <messageSize>
description: Size of each bytesMessage. The producer will use JMS BytesMessage.

options.label: <message>
description: Content of each textMessage. The producer will use JMS TextMessage.

options.label: <textMessageSize>
description: Size of each textMessage. The producer will use JMS TextMessage.

options.label: <objectSize>
description: Size of each ObjectMessage. The producer will use JMS ObjectMessage.

options.label: <msgTTL>
description: TTL for each message.

options.label: <msgGroupID>
description: Message Group to be used.

options.label: <file>
description: Messages will be read from the specified file. Other message options will be ignored.

options.label: <properties>
description: The properties to set on the message in JSON, e.g.: [{"type":"string","key":"myKey1","value":"myValue1"},{"type":"string","key":"myKey2","value":"myValue2"}]. Valid types are boolean, byte, short, int, long, float, double, and string.

commands.name: transfer
description: Move messages from one JMS destination towards another JMS destination.

options.label: <verbose>
description: Print additional information.

options.label: <silentInput>
description: Disable all the inputs, and make a best guess for any required input.

options.label: <sourceURL>
description: URL for the source broker. Default: build URL from 'artemis' acceptor defined in the broker.xml or tcp://localhost:61616 if the default cannot be parsed.

options.label: <sourceAcceptor>
description: Acceptor from the local broker.xml used to build URL towards the broker. Default: 'artemis'.

options.label: <sourceUser>
description: Username for the JMS connection to the source broker.

options.label: <sourcePassword>
description: Password for the JMS connection to the source broker.

options.label: <targetURL>
description: URL for the target broker. Default: build URL from 'artemis' acceptor defined in the broker.xml or tcp://localhost:61616 if the default cannot be parsed.

options.label: <targetUser>
description: Username for the JMS connection to the target broker.

options.label: <targetPassword>
description: Password for the JMS connection to the target broker.

options.label: <receiveTimeout>
description: Amount of time (in milliseconds) to wait before giving up the receiving loop; 0 means no wait, -1 means wait forever. Default: 5000.

options.label: <sourceClientID>
description: JMS client ID to be associated with source connection.

options.label: <sourceProtocol>
description: Protocol used. Valid values are amqp or core. Default: core.

options.label: <sourceQueue>
description: Source JMS queue to transfer messages from. Cannot be used in conjunction with --source-topic.

options.label: <sharedDurableSubscription>
description: Name of the JMS shared durable subscription to be used on the source JMS topic.

options.label: <sharedSubscription>
description: Name of the JMS shared non-durable subscription name to be used on the source JMS topic.

options.label: <durableConsumer>
description: Name of the JMS unshared durable subscription to be used on the source JMS topic.

options.label: <noLocal>
description: Use noLocal when applicable on topic operation

options.label: <sourceTopic>
description: Source JMS topic to be used. Cannot be used in conjuction with --source-queue.

options.label: <filter>
description: Filter to be used with the source consumer.

options.label: <targetProtocol>
description: Protocol used. Valid values are amqp or core. Default: core.

options.label: <commitInterval>
description: How many messages to transfer before committing the associated transaction. Default: 1000.

options.label: <copy>
description: Copy messages instead of transferring them.

options.label: <targetQueue>
description: Target JMS queue to be used. Cannot be set with --target-topic.

options.label: <targetTopic>
description: Target JMS topic to be used. Cannot bet set with --target-queue.

options.label: <messageCount>
description: Number of messages to transfer.

options.label: <brokerURL>
description: Connection URL. Default: build URL from the 'artemis' acceptor defined in the broker.xml or tcp://localhost:61616 if the acceptor cannot be parsed.

options.label: <hdrFileName>

options.label: <durableSubscription>

options.label: <persistent>

options.label: <messageSize>

options.label: <rate>

options.label: <ttl>

options.label: <msgGroupID>

description: Create --threads shared connections among producers. Default: not shared.

options.label: <producersPerDestination>

options.label: <threads>

options.label: <maxPending>
description: How many not yet completed messages can exists. Default: 1.

options.label: <consumerUrl>
description: The url used for MessageListener(s) connections. Default: same as --url.

options.label: <consumerProtocol>

options.label: <enableMessageID>
description: Set JMS messageID per-message. Default: disabled.

options.label: <enableTimestamp>
description: Set JMS timestamp per-message. Default: disabled.

parameters.label: <destinations>
description: List of destination names. Each name can be prefixed with queue:// or topic:// and can be an FQQN in the form of <address>::<queue>. Default: queue://TEST.

commands.name: stat
description: Print basic stats of a queue. Output includes CONSUMER_COUNT (number of consumers), MESSAGE_COUNT (current message count on the queue, including scheduled, paged and in-delivery messages), MESSAGES_ADDED (messages added to the queue), DELIVERING_COUNT (messages broker is currently delivering to consumer(s)), MESSAGES_ACKED (messages acknowledged from the consumer(s)). Queues can be filtered using EITHER '--queueName X' where X is contained in the queue name OR using a full filter '--field NAME --operation EQUALS --value X'.

options.label: <verbose>
description: Print additional information.

options.label: <silentInput>
description: Disable all the inputs, and make a best guess for any required input.

options.label: <brokerURL>
description: Connection URL. Default: build URL from the 'artemis' acceptor defined in the broker.xml or tcp://localhost:61616 if the acceptor cannot be parsed.

options.label: <acceptor>
description: Name used to find the default connection URL on the acceptor list. If an acceptor with that name cannot be found the CLI will look for a connector with the same name.

options.label: <user>
description: User used to connect.

options.label: <password>
description: Password used to connect.

options.label: <clientID>
description: ClientID set on the connection.

options.label: <protocol>
description: Protocol used. Valid values are ${COMPLETION-CANDIDATES}

options.label: <queueName>
description: Display queue stats for queue(s) with names containing this string.

options.label: <fieldName>
description: The field to filter. Possible values: NAME, ADDRESS, MESSAGE_COUNT, MESSAGES_ADDED, DELIVERING_COUNT, MESSAGES_ACKED, SCHEDULED_COUNT, ROUTING_TYPE.

options.label: <operationName>
description: The operation to filter. Possible values: CONTAINS, NOT_CONTAINS, EQUALS, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN.

options.label: <value>
description: The value to filter.

options.label: <maxRows>
description: The max number of queues displayed. Default is 50.

options.label: <maxColumnSize>
description: The max width of data column. Set to -1 for no limit. Default is 25.

options.label: <clustered>
description: Expands the report for all nodes on the topology

options.label: <includeManagement>
description: Include queues created for notification management in the output

options.label: <useLoop>
description: Keep Queue Stat in a forever loop, that you can interrupt with Ctrl-C, sleeping for --loop-time between each iteration.

options.label: <oldSleep>
description: Amount of Milliseconds to sleep before each iteration on queue stat. Default=60000

options.label: <loopSleep>
description: Amount of Milliseconds to sleep before each iteration on queue stat. Default=60000

description: The folder used for large-messages. Default: read from broker.xml.

options.label: <tries>

options.label: <nosyncs>
description: Disable syncs.

options.label: <syncs>
description: Enable syncs.

options.label: <journalType>
description: Journal type to be used: Default: read from broker.xml.

options.label: <syncWrites>
description: Perform each write synchronously, e.g. if there was a single producer.

options.label: <fileName>
description: The file name to be used. Default: test.tmp.

options.label: <maxAIO>

commands.name: create
description: Create a new broker instance.

options.label: <verbose>
description: Print additional information.

options.label: <silentInput>
description: Disable all the inputs, and make a best guess for any required input.

options.label: <etc>
description: Directory where Apache Artemis configuration is located. Paths can be absolute or relative to artemis.instance directory. Default: etc.

options.label: <data>
description: Directory where Apache Artemis data is stored. Paths can be absolute or relative to artemis.instance directory. Default: data.

options.label: <home>
description: Directory where Apache Artemis is installed.

options.label: <encoding>
description: The encoding that text files should use. Default: UTF-8.

options.label: <windows>
description: Force Windows script creation. Default: based on your actual system.

options.label: <nix>
description: Force Linux or Cygwin script creation. Default: based on your actual system.

options.label: <javaOptions>
description: Extra Java options to be passed to the profile.

options.label: <javaUtilityOptions>
description: Extra Java options to be passed to the utility profile.

options.label: <javaMemory>
description: Define the -Xmx memory parameter for the broker. Default: 2G.

options.label: <host>
description: Broker's host name. Default: 0.0.0.0 or input if clustered).

options.label: <httpHost>
description: Embedded web server's host name. Default: localhost.

options.label: <relaxJolokia>
description: Disable strict checking in jolokia-access.xml.

options.label: <ping>
description: A comma separated string to be passed on to the broker config as network-check-list. The broker will shutdown when all these addresses are unreachable.

options.label: <defaultPort>
description: The port number to use for the main 'artemis' acceptor. Default: 61616.

options.label: <httpPort>
description: Embedded web server's port. Default: 8161.

options.label: <sslKey>
description: Embedded web server's key store path.

options.label: <sslKeyPassword>
description: The key store's password.

options.label: <useClientAuth>
description: Require client certificate authentication when connecting to the embedded web server.

options.label: <sslTrust>
description: The trust store path in case of client authentication.

options.label: <sslTrustPassword>
description: The trust store's password.

options.label: <name>
description: The name of the broker. Default: same as host name.

options.label: <portOffset>
description: How much to off-set the ports of every acceptor.

options.label: <force>
description: Overwrite configuration at destination directory.

options.label: <purgePageFolders>
description: Paged folders should be removed upon leaving page state.

options.label: <clustered>
description: Enable clustering.

options.label: <discoveryEnabled>
description: Enable server discovery.

options.label: <maxHops>
description: Number of hops on the cluster configuration.

options.label: <messageLoadBalancing>
description: Message load balancing policy for cluster. Default: ON_DEMAND. Valid values: ON_DEMAND, STRICT, OFF, OFF_WITH_REDISTRIBUTION.

options.label: <replicated>
description: Enable broker replication.

options.label: <sharedStore>
description: Enable broker shared store.

options.label: <slave>
description: Deprecated for removal. Use 'backup' instead.

options.label: <backup>
description: Be a backup broker. Valid for shared store or replication.

options.label: <failoverOnShutodwn>
description: Whether broker shutdown will trigger failover for clients using the core protocol. Valid only for shared store. Default: false.

options.label: <clusterUser>
description: The user to use for clustering. Default: input.

options.label: <clusterPassword>
description: The password to use for clustering. Default: input.

options.label: <allowAnonymous>
description: Allow connections from users with no security credentials. Opposite of --require-login. Default: input.

options.label: <requireLogin>
description: Require security credentials from users for connection. Opposite of --allow-anonymous.

options.label: <paging>
description: Page messages to disk when address becomes full. Opposite of --blocking. Default: true.

options.label: <blocking>
description: Block producers when address becomes full. Opposite of --paging. Default: false.

options.label: <noAutoTune>
description: Disable auto tuning of the journal-buffer-timeout in broker.xml.

options.label: <noAutoCreate>
description: Disable auto creation for addresses & queues.

options.label: <autoCreate>
description: Allow automatic creation of addresses & queues. Default: true.

options.label: <autoDelete>
description: Allow automatic deletion of addresses & queues. Default: false.

options.label: <user>
description: The username. Default: input.

options.label: <password>
description: The user's password. Default: input.

options.label: <role>
description: The name for the role created. Default: amq.

options.label: <noWeb>
description: Whether to omit the web-server definition from bootstrap.xml.

options.label: <queues>
description: A comma separated list of queues with the option to specify a routing type, e.g. --queues myQueue1,myQueue2:multicast. Routing-type default: anycast.

options.label: <addresses>
description: A comma separated list of addresses with the option to specify a routing type, e.g. --addresses myAddress1,myAddress2:anycast. Routing-type default: multicast.

options.label: <aio>
description: Set the journal as asyncio.

options.label: <nio>
description: Set the journal as nio.

options.label: <mapped>
description: Set the journal as mapped.

options.label: <disablePersistence>
description: Disable message persistence to the journal

options.label: <noAmqpAcceptor>
description: Disable the AMQP specific acceptor.

options.label: <noMqttAcceptor>
description: Disable the MQTT specific acceptor.

options.label: <noStompAcceptor>
description: Disable the STOMP specific acceptor.

options.label: <noHornetQAcceptor>
description: Disable the HornetQ specific acceptor.

options.label: <noJournalSync>
description: Disable usage of fdatasync (channel.force(false) from Java NIO) on the journal.

options.label: <journalDeviceBlockSize>
description: The block size of the journal's storage device. Default: 4096.

options.label: <retentionDays>
description: Configure journal retention in days. If > 0 then enable journal-retention-directory from broker.xml allowing replay options.

options.label: <retentionMaxBytes>
description: Maximum number of bytes to keep in the retention directory.

options.label: <globalMaxSize>
description: Maximum amount of memory which message data may consume. Default: half of the JVM's max memory.

options.label: <globalMaxMessages>
description: Maximum number of messages that will be accepted in memory before using address full policy mode. Default: undefined.

options.label: <jdbc>
description: Store message data in JDBC instead of local files.

options.label: <staticNode>
description: Cluster node connectors list separated by comma, e.g. "tcp://server:61616,tcp://server2:61616,tcp://server3:61616".

options.label: <supportAdvisory>
description: Support advisory messages for the OpenWire protocol.

options.label: <suppressInternalManagementObjects>
description: Do not register any advisory addresses/queues for the OpenWire protocol with the broker's management service.

options.label: <securityManager>
description: Which security manager to use - jaas or basic. Default: jaas.

options.label: <journalMaxIo>
description: The journal-max-io value to use when also using the ASYNCIO journal-type. When using NIO or MAPPED this value is always '1'. Default: 4096

options.label: <jdbcBindings>
description: Name of the jdbc bindings table.

options.label: <jdbcMessages>
description: Name of the jdbc messages table.

options.label: <jdbcLargeMessages>
description: Name of the large messages table.

options.label: <jdbcPageStore>
description: Name of the page store messages table.

options.label: <jdbcNodeManager>
description: Name of the jdbc node manager table.

options.label: <jdbcURL>
description: The URL used for the database connection.

options.label: <jdbcClassName>
description: JDBC driver classname.

options.label: <jdbcNetworkTimeout>
description: Network timeout (in milliseconds).

options.label: <jdbcLockRenewPeriod>
description: Lock Renew Period (in milliseconds).

options.label: <jdbcLockExpiration>
description: Lock expiration (in milliseconds).

parameters.label: <directory>
description: The instance directory to hold the broker's configuration and data. Path must be writable.
